{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load and clean the data
data_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(data_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders and refunded orders
df_filtered = df[~(df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99)]
df_completed = df_filtered[df_filtered['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute raw conversion rates by channel
raw_conv = df_completed.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
raw_diff = raw_conv['email'] - raw_conv['paid_search']

# Print the raw difference as required by the estimand
print(f"Raw conversion rate (email): {raw_conv['email']}")
print(f"Raw conversion rate (paid_search): {raw_conv['paid_search']}")
print(f"Raw difference (email - paid_search): {raw_diff}")"}
